attempts.why: Error text #f0a0a0 on white has ~2.1:1 contrast and is unreadable; using var(--err) #b00020 restores accessible contrast.

selfVerify.reason: Error text uses accessible #b00020 (rgb 176,0,32) not low-contrast #f0a0a0 and remains visible below form; viewport 1200x800 has no horizontal overflow (docScrollWidth 1200), 3-column grid intact, sticky header correct, no truncation/clipping beyond intended overflow:clip on images.
